query: EXPLAIN MATCH (s:V01:Space),(r:V01 {uid:'V01:RF01'}) RETURN s.uid AS space,s.geometryJson AS spaceGeometry,s.overallCoverType AS overallType,s.coverStateMeaning AS coverMeaning,r.uid AS provider,r.geometryJson AS roofGeometry,s.geometryVersion AS spaceVersion,r.geometryVersion AS roofVersion ORDER BY space
